items.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
items.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

items.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
items.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

items.title: Was an Italian chef really fired over refusal to put pineapple on pizza?
items.description: The chef had stated that putting pineapple on pizza was "offensive to his culture".

items.title: The Pitt and ER are similar enough for lawsuit to proceed, judge rules
items.description: The widow of ER creator Michael Crichton argues The Pitt is effectively a reboot of the 1990s series.

items.title: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
items.description: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.

items.title: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
items.description: Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law.
